scope: Ordinary cars and motorcycles, UK/Wales. Vehicle-specific, temporary and per-lane limits are not covered here.

legal_limits.applies: England, Scotland, Wales, NI; no street lights; no other sign
England, Scotland, Wales, NI; no street lights; no other sign

legal_limits.applies: unless signs show otherwise; restricted roads (built-up, usually residential) since September 2023; highway-authority 30 mph exceptions exist and are signed

unavailable_or_conflicting.item: No authoritative national machine-readable legal-limit dataset is used by the app. Limits come from OpenStreetMap-derived data (unverified) plus TomTom route limits (prompt-only, never stored) and National Highways temporary limits.
unavailable_or_conflicting.effect: Every app-side limit is unverified unless it is sourced to a legal rule; the app must not label it verified.

unavailable_or_conflicting.item: Wales 20 mph default vs. OSM tags that still say 30 mph (or no tag) on restricted roads.
unavailable_or_conflicting.effect: Conflict. LimitComparison shows a '?' only when TomTom disagrees; OSM-only conflicts with the Welsh default are not detected.

unavailable_or_conflicting.item: Signed 30 mph exceptions in Wales are not listed in any source used here.
unavailable_or_conflicting.effect: Unknown; must stay unknown or unverified.

unavailable_or_conflicting.item: Temporary limits (roadworks, gantries) change the legal limit without changing the map.
unavailable_or_conflicting.effect: Only National Highways temporary feed; coverage is partial.
